notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an artifact into your graveyard from the battlefield.
easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 20 minus 1 for each charge counter on Darksteel Reactor.
description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. It will enter with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield. When it does, Donatello triggers, putting a number of charge counters on Darksteel Reactor equal to the number Eternity Vessel had on it.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.
